```{r}
#| eval: false
moRphoTaxa::fill_missing_traits()
```

### Description

Creates and associates a data frame of morphological traits for flowering plants
with species occurrence matrices, including traits specific to selected families.
The resulting data frame can be exported to a specified directory as a .xlsx file.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| df | A data frame containing species occurrence records, previously loaded from the working directory. If NULL, only the morphological traits data frame is created. |
| start_col | Character. Choose either "trait full name" to load full trait names or "trait code" to load abbreviated trait codes. |

### Value

A data frame combining occurrence data with the selected morphological traits,
exported as a .xlsx file.

### Examples

```r
# Example usage:
fill_missing_traits(
  base_df = my_occurrence_data,
  trait_name = "trait full name",
  quali_specific = "passifloraceae")
```
